paragraphs.text: The Patron of the Orochi is a kami from Kamigawa that was active during the Kami War . It is the great Patron Kami of the Orochi .

The kami's appearance is that of a giant vine-scaled serpent, with face masks lining its hide. It has huge fangs, and its maw is lined with teeth, and balls of green glowing lights float around its head. It is known to eat Orochi as offerings.
